newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - St. John Knit started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - St. John Knit started.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst Stephanie Giroux said she initiated coverage of St. John Knits Inc with an attractive rating.
-- estimated earnings of $1.95 per share for the 1997 year, ending in October, and $2.35 for 1998.
-- said St. John is "quality company that makes a quality product and is a quality investment."
-- said their ready-to-wear knit products are "very distinctive," have a "classic style," and are a "niche brand in the high end of the apparel market."
-- set 12-month price target of $50. Shares rose 1/4 to 43-1/2.
-- Shares were trading at 43-3/8, up 1/8, in morning exchange trading.
